data.name: Error_Timeout
data.value: {0}: the query timed out.

data.name: Remedy_Timeout
data.value: Increase the timeout, add filters or reduce the grain.

data.name: Error_XmlaDisabled
data.value: The XMLA endpoint is not available for this workspace.

data.name: Remedy_XmlaDisabled
data.value: Ask a Fabric/Power BI administrator to enable XMLA read on the capacity and confirm the workspace is on Premium, PPU or Fabric capacity, or use the REST transport.

data.name: Error_Capacity
data.value: This workspace does not support XMLA connections (no Premium, PPU or Fabric capacity).

data.name: Remedy_Capacity
data.value: Use the REST transport for this model or move the workspace to a supported capacity.

data.name: Error_WorkspaceNotFound
data.value: {0}: the workspace was not found for the signed-in account.

data.name: Remedy_WorkspaceNotFound
data.value: Paste the workspace connection link (Power BI: Workspace settings → License info → Connection link) into the workspace field. Check that the tenant is the workspace's tenant, and that the account is a member of the workspace (without a client ID, XMLA uses your Windows account unless you enter one in the Account field), and that the workspace is on Premium, PPU or Fabric capacity (XMLA needs one).

data.name: Error_Permission
data.value: Access was denied for this model.

data.name: Remedy_Permission
data.value: Ask the model owner for Build (or Read) permission on the semantic model and access to the workspace.

data.name: Error_SignInExpired

data.name: Remedy_SignInAgain

data.name: Error_Network

data.name: Remedy_Network
data.value: Check that Power BI Desktop is still running (local models) or your network/VPN connection (Service models), then retry.
